versions.changelog:
- Initial release of yiming-weibo-daily.
- Sends selected Zhang Yiming Weibo quotes every hour via Feishu private message, including topic tags and daily practice.
- Auto-installs, configures, previews, test-sends, and troubleshoots with priority reuse of existing Feishu credentials.
- Includes detailed usage, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting steps.
- Provides both automated and manual (local) execution options.
